_site_name_help: Brand name (final, picked Oct 21, 2026). Written as one CamelCase word; the header/footer wordmark highlights the middle word. Changing it renames titles, logo, feeds, og image and llms.txt.
tagline: There's a bot for that. Here's how.
subtagline: See what AI agents are doing for real people, and build your own.
description: A live, sourced feed of real things people hand to AI agents (inbox and phone calls, shopping, travel, family, health, work, small business), with real popularity numbers, plain-English guides, copy-paste prompts, build-your-own-bot blueprints and tips to run your bots for less.
_cname_help: Leave empty until botsdothat.com is bought and DNS points to GitHub Pages. Then follow ops/domain_cutover.md (scripts/domain_cutover.sh sets cname + base_url together).
_contact_help: contact_email wins if set. Otherwise contact links point to contact_url (GitHub issues). Never derive an email from an unowned domain.

newsletter._help: Kit form (id 10088120, uid e874d57257), double opt-in. form_action is Kit's POST URL; email_field must be email_address. Forms submit via fetch (Accept: application/json) with an inline message, falling back to a normal POST. If form_action is empty, the form is shown disabled and sends nothing.

meta_description: See what AI agents are doing for real people, with sources and real popularity numbers. Then build your own with copy-paste bot blueprints. Updated daily.

verification._help: Paste only the content value of each tag. Google Search Console > Add property > URL prefix > HTML tag gives <meta name="google-site-verification" content="XXXX">: paste XXXX into google. Bing Webmaster Tools > HTML Meta Tag gives msvalidate.01: paste its content into bing. Empty = no tag is output.

analytics._help: Cloudflare Web Analytics public beacon token (Cloudflare > Analytics & Logs > Web Analytics). Empty = no beacon tag is output.

_x_handle_help: Brand X account (created Oct 23, 2026). Used for the footer/about link, twitter:site and Organization sameAs.

sponsor_checkout._help: Stripe Payment Links for /advertise/ 'Book & pay' buttons. Put LIVE-mode links (https://buy.stripe.com/..., never /test_) in links, then set live=true. While live is false or any link is empty, /advertise/ keeps the 'Email us' buttons. sandbox_links are the test-mode copies (BotsDoThat sandbox acct_1UToXNBHg6I95Fjd) for trying checkout with card 4242 4242 4242 4242; they are never shown on the site. promo_code = Founding sponsor code (featured listing, first month free, first 3 sponsors). newsletter_promo_code = code for the first 2 newsletter issues sold free (max 2 uses, newsletter product only). Run for less and Bundle links each stop after 1 completed sale (both include the single Run for less tile); when one sells, deactivate the other in Stripe until that month ends. No secret keys here, ever.
